messages:
Alex: FYI — Acme just pushed an urgent ask: they want Okta + SCIM provisioning in the MVP. They say it’s blocking their pilot.
Priya: Can they accept a v1 timeline? what deadline are they aiming for?
Alex: Pilot start target = May 24 from Acme. That gives ~6 weeks. Est: Okta + SCIM end-to-end is ~3 dev sprints + infra + e2e -> likely blows past MVP date unless we cut something.
Marisol: Alternatives? SAML-only, OIDC-only, or manual invites for provisioning?
Jay: Minimal path options:
- Option A: OIDC login only + manual provisioning (ship MVP on time)
- Option B: Full Okta + SCIM now (push MVP ~3 weeks)
- Option C: OIDC + feature-flagged provider plumbing, SCIM in v1 (split rollout)
Priya: Main concern: sales/customer feels blocked. Technical concern: adding SCIM touches infra + auditing + retry logic.
Sam: If we keep ship date, we need to de-scope something else. Propose deprioritizing admin delegation or analytics dashboard. Which has less enterprise impact?
Marisol: Analytics is a major ask from other customers too. Admin delegation usage is expected to be low initially — I'd cut delegation and keep analytics.
Alex: Can eng deliver OIDC + feature toggle in 2 sprints? Jay?
Jay: Yes. OIDC + flag + basic Okta verification should fit 2 sprints if we avoid SCIM provisioning. SCIM needs user sync contracts + QA matrix => separate.
deploy-bot: :bell: Reminder: upcoming freeze window starts at 1767445200 (next Wed). Plan accordingly.
Priya: Proposal (recommended): Ship OIDC login + feature-flagged provider plumbing for Okta in MVP, postpone full SCIM provisioning to v1. Cut admin delegation from MVP. PM to update sales docs and cutlist.
Alex: Action items: I’ll draft a 1-pager risk note and inform Acme. Schedule a quick alignment with Solutions & Sales at 11:30.
Marisol: Add acceptance criteria: Okta login successful for 2 enterprise test orgs, rollback plan, and smoke-test script.
Jay: Adding a tiny smoke test snippet for validation:
```
# smoke auth test
curl -s -X POST https://platform.example.com/auth/oidc/callback -d '{"code":"test-code"}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' | jq '.status' # expect "ok"
```
Priya: Assignments: Alex -> risk note + customer comms; Jay -> eng task breakdown and estimate by EOD; Marisol -> test criteria and e2e matrix; Sam -> update cutlist & release notes.
Alex: Thanks—I'll update this thread after the 11:30 sync :thumbsup:
